digest.component_or_area: plan review criteria routing / LLM-routed enumeration
propositions: T13, T14, removal-rationale, and asserted-capability produced zero findings across ~7,900 agentic runs due to missing or overly broad applicability vocabulary.

A deterministic pre-filter gate (text_all regex conjunctions, file_impact glob/reason matching) must fire before the LLM router is invoked, skipping criteria only when subject vocabulary is entirely absent.
Criterion skip events must be recorded in the sidecar's coverage.routing.det_gated dict keyed by criterion id with the rule name, visible for every gated run.
asserted-capability requires both text_all legs (module-ref and capability-verb regexes) to match; firing on only one leg must not occur.
The migrated T5a/T5d/T7/T12 overlay rules must fire identically to their current plain-regex behavior on representative texts.
